title: Upcoming Events – Autumn 2018
html:
The autumn of 2018 has plenty of events where Kamailio developers and community members will participate. Among them:

  • Kamailio Developers Event, during September 27-28, in Dusseldorf, Germany
  • Kamailio On Tap – Free Community Meetup on the evening (19:00) of the 27th of September, in Dusseldorf, Germany
  • Astricon 2018, during October 9-11, in Orlando, USA
  • TADHack Global, during October 13-14, Worldwide
  • #Berlin5GWeek, during November 12-16, in Berlin, Germany
  • Kamailio Advanced Training, during November 12-14, in Berlin, Germany
  • TAD Summit, during November 13-14, in Lisbon, Portugal
  • VoIP2Day, during November 14-15, in Madrid, Spain
  • FUSECO Forum, during November 15-16, in Berlin, Germany

If you attend any of these events or are around their location at their dates, get in contact with Kamailio’s community via sr-users mailing list and let’s meet, greet and discuss latest news about the project and RTC market.

Enjoy the autumn!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
